# BoxCast

> > BoxCast provides professional live video streaming solutions with hardware encoders (BoxCast Flow, Spark), cloud transcoding, and multi-destination broadcasting for churches, schools, and organizations.

BoxCast specializes in reliable live streaming technology featuring proprietary encoders, HEVC cloud transcoding, adaptive bitrate streaming, and integrated tools like RemoteMix for audio mixing and BoxCast Sites for website hosting. The platform serves houses of worship, educational institutions, and broadcast organizations seeking professional-grade streaming without technical complexity.

## Key Topics

- BoxCast Flow encoder
- Spark Encoder
- HEVC cloud transcoding
- Adaptive bitrate streaming
- RemoteMix audio mixing
- Multi-destination streaming
- Church live streaming
- School sports broadcasting
- RTMP and SRT protocols
- BoxCast Sites
- Mixing Station Anywhere
- Professional video production
- Responsive video embeds
- House of worship streaming
- Live streaming monetization
